title: Melange: A Synthetic Visual Bias Benchmark for Multi-modal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice visual question answering on ambiguous synthetic images featuring characters of different ages, measuring the model's neutral abstention rate (Fairness Ratio) and polarity-aware stereotype alignment.

Multiple-choice visual question answering on ambiguous synthetic images featuring characters of different genders, measuring the model's neutral abstention rate (Fairness Ratio) and polarity-aware stereotype alignment.

Multiple-choice visual question answering on ambiguous synthetic images featuring characters with differing physical appearances, measuring the model's neutral abstention rate (Fairness Ratio) and polarity-aware stereotype alignment.

Multiple-choice visual question answering on ambiguous synthetic images featuring characters depicting different socioeconomic statuses, measuring the model's neutral abstention rate (Fairness Ratio) and polarity-aware stereotype alignment.

Multiple-choice visual question answering on ambiguous synthetic images featuring characters of different racial or ethnic backgrounds, measuring the model's neutral abstention rate (Fairness Ratio) and polarity-aware stereotype alignment.

Multiple-choice visual question answering on ambiguous synthetic images featuring characters with different visible religious markers, measuring the model's neutral abstention rate (Fairness Ratio) and polarity-aware stereotype alignment.

Multiple-choice visual question answering on ambiguous synthetic images featuring characters with and without visible disabilities, measuring the model's neutral abstention rate (Fairness Ratio) and polarity-aware stereotype alignment.
